description.value:
You can only benefit from one Theme ability at a time. If you have multiple Theme abilities, you can change which one is active when you finish a rest and any time you spend Immersion on an ability.

Add this to your sheet and any theme abilities you gain will be listed under this ability's dropdown.

resource.name: Theme
resource.rechargeMessage: Can be changed any time you finish a rest or spend Immersion.
